asr.full_text: What's up everyone? I'm Ninja. I'm here to answer all of your questions about Fortnite on Twitter. This is Fortnite Support. AnishaMarie0301 asks, Ninja, so I'm trying to learn how to play with mouse and keyboard on. Fortnite and I was wondering what control setups do you use or prefer? What control setup? I don't. Really think there is a control setup for mouse and keyboard. I'm just going to tell you what my. Keybinds are right now off the rip. So shift is my pyramid. I have auto run enabled because that's. That's how I obviously have shift as something else. So definitely enable auto run. Q is my platform and my two side mouse buttons. Are my wall and my ramp,. Which are arguably the most important building key binds. So if you have a mouse,. Highly recommend getting a mouse. With two or three buttons on it. And make sure you map two of your building options. To your mouse buttons. This question is from Fork Buns,. At Twitch Fork Buns,. Says you can be good at Fortnite,. But you'll never be good enough. How do you compete with people. Have over half a month of in-game time that's legit 16 days of your life hashtag fortnite. Uh i mean you're not going to be better than those players. You know what i mean i mean it's one of those things you just kind of have to accept that. Right i mean like if i'm a basketball player and i practice one hour a day and lebron plays. 10 hours 12 hours a day because it's it's like it's his job and it's what you know and i i can't. Complain about how he's gonna be better than me when he has all day to play. You know what I mean? It's one of those things where it's just like, dude, it's just, it's the way of the road. Oh no! At Fuzzy Monster with a three as the E says, at Fortnite Gaming question,. How do you shoot down a loot carrier from 50 meters on mobile? They fall out of render distance. Hashtag help needed, hashtag support, hashtag Fortnite, hashtag challenge, hashtag no can do. Maybe a little less hashtags. I don't think you can do anything about that. I think it's just,. You know stop playing mobily and get an xbox or a pc to fix that issue fuzzy but i know that's not. The answer that you want unfortunately there's no answer that i can provide um you know what let me. Just give a call a quick call to epic games and see if they can uh patch that for you though z. Ball official asks what's the best landing spot for competitive fortnite first of all you need. To know who you're playing against uh if there's just gonna be random tournaments and you don't. Know exactly who is gonna get in your lobbies i think that you want to just go with what is going. To be the least contested that will get you the most loot don't go for the heavily contested. Unless you are truly the best player in the game someone lands and gets a better weapon than you. And just ruins your tournament it's uh it's really unfortunate because you're landing at a heavy. Contested spot ij gemini says so i suck at fortnite quick editing slash building i watch people build. Hollywood mansions in five seconds flat while taking i'm taking five minutes to do a 90. any. Advice for the building slash editing unendowed just sit and creative for 30 minutes a day in the. The mornings and at nights and just practice your building. It's that easy. Just sit there and just. Build, listen to some music and just crank out your nineties, man. You will learn. You will perfect. It. I promise you. It's exactly what I had to do when I, when I started falling off building wise. And editing wise, I just sat in creative and practice it, man. You got to work for it. I know. You're looking for a quick, easy tip or something that is just going to make you improve immediately. And that doesn't exist. Build forever. So you can, you put down a wall and then you just practice. You're editing and you're on editing, you're editing and you're on editing over and over again. Rinse and repeat. Oh, at Hillbilly Runamuck says, how does anyone play in a random squad in hashtag. Fortnite? I'm just barely above being a bot and I rarely get in squads that outlast me. And it's. More than six years old. This is an interesting question, but I definitely know that there are a. Lot of younger kids that do squad fill. Hillbilly, my advice to you would be to do some squad fills. And try to find people who aren't six years old. And whenever you do get those teammates in your. Game, try to, you know, connect with them, add them and start running games with them. And then. Eventually you're going to build up a squad of people that you can game with and not to squad. Those with. That's what I did back in the day in Halo 2 when I was, I mean, this is like 10, 12,. 13 years ago, maybe more 15 years ago, I needed to play team hardcore or matchmaking with other. People. So I would just go in. And once I found someone who I kind of connected with, I'd be like,. Yo, man, you're good. You want to run? And then boom, there you go. Try it out. Mr. Appy Gaming. Says, what is your main skin in Fortnite? There's a female ninja skin in the game. That's pretty. Dope. I think that I use her the most. At Galaxy Shadow GG says, anyone know what the symbol means. On Fortnite? Dude, I literally just asked this question. I was doing squad fills the other day. I don't know. I don't know what that means. It's like, it's just a globe. I think it might mean. That someone maybe from another server is playing on a server that they shouldn't be playing on. So they just have a globe icon. I don't know what that means. It's not mobile. It kind of looks like. Controller it might be the new ps4 your guess is as good as mine man but it's definitely not pc and. I don't think it's xbox we have a question from mr c's celeb cues said at ninja how do you get so. Good at playing fortnite from jayden age nine that's a really good question i've been playing. Video games my entire life i'm 28 years old and you learn a lot about different gaming play styles. As you play different games and honestly i just put the time in my entire life to be good at video. Games. The more you play, the better you're going to get. And when you do play, actually try to. Improve your game. There are two ways you can play video games. You can play casually, or you can. Play competitively. And if you're just playing casually, and you're messing around, and you're. Landing the same spots, and you're farming the same way, and you use the same guns all the time,. And you never change anything, and you never actually try to improve, you're not going to. Improve, right? So you need to honestly actively work on, you know, your shooting, your building,. And your knowledge of the map and rotating and things like that. So yeah, put the time in, practice hard and actively try to improve. At Crawly4 asks,. Hello, mate. Can you tell me how to improve my aim in Fortnite, please? Question mark, crawling face. For me, with any sensitivity or any aiming issues,. What you want to do is you want to start at a lower sensitivity, right? If you really can't just hit, if you can't hit, just lower your sensitivity. And you won't be able to miss. Literally, it'll be two. So slow that you should be hitting everything that you're aiming at. When you are eliminated,. Because your aim is too slow, you bump it up just a little bit. Then once you've moved it up a little. Bit, take a little bit of getting used to, but then once you get eliminated again, because your. Aim is too slow, you bump it up a little bit. And eventually you're going to keep doing this. You're. Going to keep going back and forth until you find the perfect medium. You're finally got a good. Sensitivity where you're now your aim is pretty solid and you're no longer getting eliminated. Because your sensitivity is too slow. It's a lot easier to go from down up than to go from an. Incredibly high sensitivity and work your way down. So try it out. Let me know. At Modded Potato. Asks, what's your favorite Fortnite loadout? If you play, if you don't, that's fine. Here's mine. For me, my favorite loadout has got to be the Flapjacky, the Flapjacky Back Bling, and the. Black and White with the Chrono Contrail and also the same glider that you have, the Pixel Glider. It's definitely one of my favorites. Good job. Good taste. At what you do as G says,. What is most important in Fortnite? Mechanics or game sense? Good question. They're both important. You need to focus on them both. I think your game sense will let you live. And last longer in your lobbies. However, mechanics are going to be how you win those games. You cannot win a game solely off of game sense. Or you will win less games. So focus on both. At Little Luiso asks,. If I wanna play hashtag Fortnite. Just to chill with the friends,. What do I have to do? Play Team Rumble? Oh wait, is there skill-based matchmaking. In Team Rumble 2? At Fortnite game. Little Luiso, I feel your pain here, man. And Team Rumble is definitely going. To be the chillest playlist. But also, I mean, if you're playing with your friends. And you're just chilling,. Shouldn't you be able to play squads? And just like, I mean, like how good are you? I guess. But I understand what you're saying, man. I don't agree with the skill-based matchmaking. It does make the lobbies a lot sweatier. Skill-based matchmaking right now is basically adding longer queues. You're playing against tougher players if you're a good player. And it's basically turning into arena without siphon mode. And that's kind of what arena is for, is for those competitive and sweaty matches. Only time will tell, man. At iFireMonkey says, what strats do you use in Fortnite? For me, I hide under stairs and in bushes like the true bot that I am. That's the beautiful thing about Fortnite, man, is you can play however you want. If you want to bush camp, if you want to hide under stairs, you can do that. I still highly recommend learning how to build and learning how to shoot. So that when you do get in situations where someone finds you under those stairs,. You can win those fights. So. Our next and final question comes from NotKai. So what is the best shotgun in Fortnite? It's a great question, dude. All right. The answer is they're all good. The pump shotgun is great if you have an SMG and an AR. But if you only have like an infantry rifle and a sniper rifle and you don't really have. A spray gun, you need a shotgun that's going to shoot faster, which is where the Tac shotgun. Comes in, bro. So it all depends on your play style. What do you like? Do you want to be able to one pump someone? Do you want to be able to shoot multiple shotgun shots if you miss one? Figure it out. Feel it out. I personally love the pump shotgun. Alright everyone, that is it for today. Thank you guys for all of your questions and I hope you guys keep enjoying Fortnite. Thanks for watching. Thank you. We'll see you next time.
